name: sheet
title: Sheet
description: A panel that slides in from any edge — Dialog semantics with a side, a header and a footer.

meta.whenToUse: Secondary content beside the page — filters, details, a settings panel — that should not take the centre of the screen.
meta.whenNotToUse: A decision (AlertDialog), a centred form (Dialog), or a touch-first panel with snap points (Drawer).
